description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardRxPrefs' that manages shared preferences and reactive subscriptions for keyboard settings in the AnySoftKeyboard project. It handles preference changes, applies locale settings, and manages disposables for reactive streams.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardRxPrefs
classes.description: An abstract class that manages reactive shared preferences for the soft keyboard, handling preference changes, locale application, and disposables.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes preferences, registers listeners, and sets up reactive subscriptions to preference changes.

methods.name: prefs
methods.description: Returns the RxSharedPrefs instance used by this class.

methods.name: onSharedPreferenceChange
methods.description: Handles specific preference key changes, triggering critical add-on updates when necessary.

methods.name: addDisposable
methods.description: Adds a Disposable to the composite for proper cleanup.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Disposes of all subscriptions and unregisters preference change listeners.
